narrative.overview:
StatementLens is a calm white sheet of large serif figures, tracked caps and dashed hairlines, laid over a cool grey band that holds identity and navigation. It follows CRED Money's structure and feel, which the owner pinned as the binding reference, rebuilt from scratch: Gloock and Figtree stand in for CRED's commercial faces, and the buttons follow CRED's open-source NeoPOP system (Apache-2.0). No CRED logo, mark or proprietary asset appears. Every total on the sheet is a door. Tap it and you land on the rows behind it. The visual system exists so that two numbers on screen never seem to disagree: the same figure is set the same way wherever it appears, and breakdowns visibly add up to their headline.

The surface is quiet so that a few physical materials can carry the character. Primary buttons are NeoPOP slabs: a flat face on a solid 3D edge that sinks into the edge when pressed. The three money flows are extruded bars printed with a banknote weave. The spend breakdown is a ring standing on a darker, ribbed coin edge. Account pages open under a gold sunburst. Depth is always a solid, blur-free edge, never a soft shadow. Colour is rationed: near-black ink does selection and action, and three flow hues (cobalt incoming, plum spends, peach investments) appear only where that flow is drawn.

It refuses the dashboard-of-cards default: no KPI tiles, no charts in boxes, no left rail of icons. Density is relaxed, at phone scale: 56px icon discs, rows padded 14–22px, a 28px gap between blocks. Motion is spent once. The cash-flow bars grow out of their baseline when the tab opens. Nothing fades in and no figure counts up.
keyCharacteristics: Grey header band over a white sheet with 18px top corners; on desktop, a 448px list column beside a detail pane.
Gloock for headings and the hero figure, Figtree for everything else. Labels are tracked uppercase Figtree.
Paise stay on every exact figure but recede, through a solid colour mix rather than opacity.
Dashed hairlines separate rows. Solid lines are reserved for structure and chart baselines.
NeoPOP press, extruded banknote bars, a ribbed 3D donut, a gold sunburst. Depth is always solid.
Light (CRED's palette) is the default. Dark is the same structure on near-black, toggled from the band.

rules.name: The Flow Hue Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is incoming, plum is spends, peach is investments, everywhere a flow is drawn: bar, donut ramp, legend swatch, month-chart highlight. A flow hue never decorates anything that is not that flow. Charts with no single flow (a tag's or merchant's history) highlight in ink.

rules.name: The Ink Selects Rule
rules.body: A selected or primary thing is ink-on-sheet inverted: near-black fill with white text in light, the reverse in dark. Selection is never a hue.

rules.name: The Gold Speaks Rule
rules.body: Gold means the app noticed something or a mode is on, such as a detected salary cycle, a caution, or privacy. It is never used for ordinary emphasis.

rules.name: The Measured Ink Rule
rules.body: Every text colour is checked against the darkest surface it sits on in its theme, and has to clear 4.5:1 there. A failing token gets darkened. It is not tolerated.

rules.name: The One Serif Figure Rule
rules.body: Gloock sets headings and the hero figure that headlines a screen. Every other amount, however large, is Figtree 700 with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Recessive Paise Rule
rules.body: Every exact figure keeps its paise, but they are set in `color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 35%, var(--ink3))`. This is a solid colour, never opacity. Both ends of the mix clear 4.5:1 in both themes, so a green or red figure keeps its hue and its paise stay legible. The change is typographic only. Figures are never rounded.

rules.name: The Exact-or-Compact Rule
rules.body: Wherever a figure belongs to a sum that has to reconcile (hero, row, legend line, balance pill), it is exact, with Indian grouping and recessive paise (an illustrative ₹1,23,456.78). Compact two-decimal figures (₹12.40K, ₹3.20L, ₹1.05Cr) appear only on chart labels, averages and prose notes. A figure shown in two places is the same figure in the same form.

rules.name: The Caps Name Things Rule
rules.body: Tracked caps name a figure or a section. They never sit over a heading that already says the same thing. Screen headings and copy are written lowercase ("all transactions"). Only button labels start with a capital ("View all", "Confirm").

rules.name: The Sheet Over Band Rule
rules.body: Identity and navigation live on the band. Content lives on the sheet. A chart, the donut or a hero figure sits directly on the sheet, never inside a box of its own.

rules.name: The Dashed Row Rule
rules.body: Rows within a list are split by 1px dashed `--line2`. Solid rules mark structure only: the filter bar, chart baselines, gridlines.

rules.name: The Solid Edge Rule
rules.body: If it is raised, it stands on a solid edge. The edge is a darker face, offset down or down-right, with zero blur.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: A NeoPOP slab sinks by exactly its edge depth and its edges vanish. The press is the only feedback a primary button gives.

rules.name: The Two Conics
rules.body: Repeating conic gradients appear twice, both as the world's own materials (a coin's milled edge, a sunburst) and nowhere else. One is the ribbing on the donut's coin edge. The other is the account sunburst: gold rays 0.6° wide every 6°, fanning from the bottom centre over Sun Ground, behind a 220px sheet-white circle with a 1.5px gold rim that holds the 96px bank disc.

dos: **Do** put a screen's one answer in a Gloock hero (2.75rem) under a tracked caps label, and make it tappable through to its rows.
**Do** make every breakdown visibly sum to its headline. Use exact figures with recessive paise for anything that reconciles, and compact K/L/Cr only on chart labels, averages and notes.
**Do** give primary actions the NeoPOP press: an ink face, a 4px solid edge, and a sink of exactly that depth.
**Do** draw a flow only in its hue triplet (Face, Line, Side), and print the banknote weave on any extruded flow bar.
**Do** separate list rows with 1px dashed `--line2`, and keep every control at least 44px tall.
**Do** check each new text colour against the darkest surface it sits on in both themes, and darken it until it clears 4.5:1.
**Do** inline fonts (both `latin` and `latin-ext`, for ₹), icons and patterns. The page fetches nothing.
**Do** draw new icons in the app's own outline family: 24px grid, 1.6 stroke, round caps and joins, inline SVG.
donts: **Don't** build KPI tiles, boxed charts, or a left rail of icons.
**Don't** fade paise or any figure with opacity. Mix colours toward `--ink3` instead.
**Don't** use a blurred `box-shadow`. Depth is a solid edge.
**Don't** use a flow hue for decoration, or a hue of any kind for selection.
**Don't** add entrance fades, count-up figures, or a second motion moment beyond the cash-flow bars' growth.
**Don't** use repeating conic ribbing or rays outside the donut's edge and the account sunburst.
**Don't** round a rectangle you act on. Corners are 0px, pills are full, identity is a circle.
**Don't** use CRED's logos, marks, proprietary faces or assets, or any bank's logo.
